segments.ja178:1.1: Janittaṃ me bhavittaṃ me, iti paṅke avassayiṃ;
segments.ja178:1.3: Taṃ maṃ paṅko ajjhabhavi, yathā dubbalakaṃ tathā;
segments.ja178:1.5: Taṃ taṃ vadāmi bhaggava, suṇohi vacanaṃ mama.
segments.ja178:2.1: Gāme vā yadi vā raññe, sukhaṃ yatrādhigacchati;
segments.ja178:2.5: Yamhi jīve tamhi gacche, na niketahato siyāti.
